Leaders of the United States, China and Russia are set to hold an unprecedented three-way meeting next week, the White House has said.
US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin will meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China’s tech hub, the White House assistant press secretary confirmed in an announcement.
The talks will be held nine months after the last nuclear arms treaty between Washington and Moscow expired , leaving the world’s two countries with the largest atomic arsenals without caps for the first time in more than 50 years.
Trump has said the meeting is a chance for all three countries to reach a deal on nuclear stockpiles.
The New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (New START) lapsed in February. Trump then rejected Russia’s proposal to extend it for another year and demanded a “new, improved and modernised” deal that includes China.
Expectations are low. “We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement,” a senior Trump administration official told the Reuters news agency, describing the meeting as the start of a conversation.
Russia holds the most nuclear warheads, followed by the US, then China, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.
Trump plans on discussing the Iran war with Xi and Putin, but will steer away from discussing Russia’s war in Ukraine, according to a senior US official who briefed reporters on condition of anonymity.
Elon Musk will also travel with Trump to China but will not attend the meeting, the official added. Trump is also not expected to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during the Asia trip.
The planned summit has drawn comparisons with the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the leaders of the US, Britain and the Soviet Union shaped the post-war order.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, however, dismissed the parallel, saying any agreements reached in Shenzhen cannot be imposed on others, but he still called the meeting “extremely significant”.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has voiced concern that the meeting could become a platform to discuss a Ukraine deal behind Kyiv’s back.
Trump has pursued closer ties with both leaders despite a short-lived trade war with China last year and Russia’s continuing war in Ukraine, where Washington is seeking to mediate a solution.

In what the city’s mayor declared a “miracle on the Mississippi”, all passengers were accounted for – with none killed or critically hurt – after a tanker collided with a river cruise ship docked on the Mississippi River in New Orleans on Friday afternoon.
Thirty-two people were taken to local hospitals after the Atlantic Asphalt tanker struck American Cruise Lines’s American Heritage at about 12.30pm – but none of their injuries were considered critical, New Orleans’s mayor, Helena Moreno, said at a news conference.
Zero passengers or crew members were unaccounted for, Moreno said. She attributed that fact to a hectic but effective multi-agency rescue effort after the American Heritage was struck and a number of people ended up in the river, whose waters are cold and its currents are infamously perilous.
That “truly is a miracle on the Mississippi,” Moreno said near the scene of the crash, as a group of fellow officials around her applauded.
The American Heritage had 197 passengers onboard when it was hit, Port of New Orleans press secretary Kimberly Curth said in a statement.
About two hours before that, the American Heritage had docked at the port to begin passenger disembarkation, Curth said.
Thirty of those reported injured were on the American Heritage, and they were said to have mostly had bumps and bruises. Two others among the injured were harbor police officers who were on the river boat after the crash participating in rescue efforts.
Officials did not immediately provide details about what caused the crash. But New Orleans’s US coast guard commander Melanie Burnham said the tanker apparently had “some type of loss of steering” – as an emergency response source had indicated earlier.
The website MarineTraffic.com showed the Atlantic Asphalt’s path was seemingly uneventful as it went around the difficult bend in the Mississippi River near New Orleans’ Algiers Point neighborhood. It had just made it past the Crescent City Connection bridge linking New Orleans’ central business district and the community’s Algiers section when it began heading generally to its starboard – or right – side.
Video provided to Guardian reporting partner WWL Louisiana showed the Atlantic Asphalt then T-boned the side of the American Heritage. The cruise ship eventually slowly rolled on to its side where it was struck, according to the video, which the CBS affiliate obtained from Barry Kern, proprietor of Mardi Gras World, a tourist attraction near the scene of the crash.
One witness, Jamie Holford, told local NBC News affiliate WDSU that it took 15 minutes “from impact to where it rolled over”.
Maritime law expert Martin J Davies of Tulane University told the Associated Press that local pilots are onboard ships such as the Atlantic Asphalt as they travel on the Mississippi River. Those pilots know the river’s waters and the ships they are on well, Davies said.
Davies said videos circulating online of the crash suggest there was some kind of catastrophic system failure on the tanker – and some “super bad luck” for it to strike the American Heritage as passengers disembarked.
The Atlantic Asphalt was traveling slowly against the current upriver, Davies said to the AP. He added: “For something like this to happen for an upbound ship indicates that something must have gone really badly wrong.”
Separately, Davies said to local Fox affiliate WVUE that the Atlantic Asphalt was fortunate to have not hit the Crescent City Connection , which could have endangered motorists on a two-span, cantilever, steel truss bridge that is estimated to carry about 160,000 cars daily.
“This is obviously a really bad incident,” Davies said. “But it could also have struck the bridge, which it didn’t.”
A video from WDSU showed crew members of a tugboat working to pull people in lifejackets or holding on to flotation rings out of the river. An emergency response that drew in firefighters, crews of tug vessels in the vicinity, US Coast Guard helicopter and boat personnel, as well as port and city police – among others – also helped pull out people who ended up in the water in plain view of cameras and stunned eyewitnesses.
One image on social media showed people climbing on the side of the cruise boat – specifically, on stateroom balconies – after it was struck, with chairs and tables strewn about after it evidently took on water.
Blake Paterson, an independent New Orleans journalist who publishes Perdido Street.News , interviewed 65-year-old American Heritage passenger Tamara Carrasco about what she saw at the time of the crash.
The retired Atlanta elementary school teacher told Paterson that she was dining on the first floor of the riverboat when she saw the tanker careering toward the American Heritage. The tanker dropped its anchor, and she could see its crew running away on its deck, according to what Carrasco told Paterson.
Carrasco began running to the other side of the river boat, but she was knocked to the ground when the tanker hit. She said water began pouring into the dining room, making her think it was “like the Titanic”.
An employee at the Ernest N Morial Convention Center next to the scene of Friday’s crash said she realized something was awry when she could see from her vantage point that the tip of the American Heritage was tilted. She then grasped the nature of situation when she heard desperate shrieks.
“People were screaming for help,” said the employee, who asked to not be named. She recalled how she and colleagues assembled wheelchairs, water and other items in case survivors would soon need them.
Moreno said many people lost their IDs, car keys, cell phones and other belongings in the disaster. The mayor said most were from out of town.
She said the city and its partner organizations were working to ensure affected passengers had “food, hotel rooms, transportation” – and access to their prescription medication.
The American Heritage’s passengers were brought inside the New Orleans port’s administration building, next to the convention center, after the crash.
At the news conference where officials then confirmed there were no casualties, Louisiana governor Jeff Landry echoed Moreno in invoking the term “miracle”, especially “when you think about the population that was on that cruise ship – and the ability for us to get them off and out of the water”.
“The Mississippi River is not some quiet pond,” Landry said. “There were challenges out there.”
With everyone accounted for, Burnham said the focus would shift to re-opening the river to traffic. It had been closed from mile markers 93 to 96 to facilitate rescue efforts.
US House majority leader Steve Scalise, a suburban New Orleans Republican, said on Friday that the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) would investigate the crash. But Scalise said the investigative team had been slowed by a nationwide Federal Aviation Administration ground stop on Friday that had delayed or canceled more than 11,000 US flights.
The NTSB late on Friday said it would send investigators by ground to the scene of the Atlantic Asphalt-American Heritage crash.
A statement from American Cruise Lines on Friday said “guests and crew were evacuated” from the American Heritage but did not elaborate. “We are deeply concerned for everyone involved,” the cruise operator’s statement added.
The American Heritage , a 300ft paddle-wheel ship, was built in 2015 and previously sailed as the Queen of the Mississippi. It has more than 80 staterooms and operates cruises on the Mississippi River, including ones which depart from New Orleans.
The Atlantic Asphalt is a oil tanker built in 2017 measuring approximately 525 feet (160 meters) in length and has a deadweight of 17,764 metric tons. It flies the flag of the Marshall Islands and is owned and commercially operated by Nave Shipping SA, a company registered in Liberia. Its maint…

Watch: Cruise ship seen sinking after collision with cargo ship in New Orleans
Some 130 people on a cruise ship docked in New Orleans have been rescued after it was struck by a tanker.
The cruise ship, American Heritage, was left lying on its side in the Mississippi River after it was hit by the cargo vessel Atlantic Asphalt.
The collision left 32 people from the stricken riverboat in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for. Officials hailed it as a "miracle on the Mississippi".
The exact cause of the crash remains under investigation, but US Coast Guard Capt Melanie Burnham said: "There seems to be some type of a loss of steering."
New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno told a news conference that all credit in the rescue effort should go to first responders who "literally jumped right in to help".
"We have zero people unaccounted for, which truly is a miracle on the Mississippi," Moreno said.
Calls about the collision began around 13:30 EST (18:30 GMT) on Friday, when people began trying to help passengers escape the boat as it took on water, Port of New Orleans chief Melanie Montroll told the news conference.
There were about 129 passengers, in addition to crew members, on the American Heritage at the time of the collision, according to the port authority.
Passengers began getting off the paddlewheeler vessel, operated by American Cruise Lines, as it started listing before tipping onto its side, Moreno said.
Tugboat operators, police and other rescuers rushed to help while officials shut down traffic in the Mississippi River during the rescue effort.
The American Heritage had been finishing an eight-day cruise calling at destinations in Louisiana and Mississippi along the waterway.
US President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that the rescue had been an "incredible job".
Governor Jeff Landry also hailed the rescue as a "miracle on the Mississippi" given the "sheer number of people who were on that cruise ship" who were rescued.
Ships have operated safely on the Mississippi River for years, Landry said, pledging to investigate what had occurred.
Jamie Holford, a witness to the crash, told the BBC's US partner CBS that he had seen the cruise ship hit the dock following the collision.
"It sounded like a war movie. Just imagine tons of steel crunching. That's what it sounded like," he said. "It looked like something off the Titanic."
Holford added that he had seen passengers and crew "hollering" and "crying" as they tried to get off the ship while it was sinking.
The American Heritage can carry up to 150 guests and features a glass-enclosed restaurant, fitness centre and three guest lounges, according to its website.

US negotiators have touted the idea of Ukraine withdrawing its remaining forces from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for Nato membership, Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
The Ukrainian president's comments on Saturday come after US envoys visited Moscow and an EU summit in Dublin as part of ongoing efforts to end the war between Russia and Ukraine.
Kyiv has long sought membership of the military alliance as a condition of any peace deal to deter future threats, while Russia has said another Nato member on its border was unacceptable.
Zelensky has also consistently said Ukraine was unwilling to give up sovereign territory, despite Moscow's demands for it to cede the Donbas.
"The Americans raised a question: 'What if Ukraine joins Nato? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?' This was the first time this had been raised," Zelensky told reporters on Saturday.
He went on to say that if he received a proposal that contained security guarantees, no constraints on Ukraine's military and funds to rebuild the country, he would put it to a referendum.
US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travelled to the Irish capital on Thursday to meet Zelensky, after a round of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow the day prior.
Comments by both Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted, and that Moscow's demands for territory and neutrality continue to far exceed what Ukraine is prepared to consider.
Moscow has previously proposed limits on the size of Ukraine's military, territorial concessions and Kyiv's guaranteed neutrality as conditions of a peace deal.
Ukraine has rejected these, arguing that such constraints would hamper its ability to stave off any future invasion.
There have, however, been recent signs the two can find common ground: last month, US First Lady Melania Trump was able to broker a temporary ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky to allow for evacuations and aid deliveries.
US officials had previously said that Ukrainian Nato membership was off the table.
Zelensky said on Saturday that the US proposal made him believe that "Nato is back on the agenda".
But he cautioned: "You have also heard Putin's signals, and this is an extremely difficult conversation."
Russia currently occupies roughly a fifth of Ukrainian territory, including most of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions that compose the Donbas.
Ceding the small portions of land Ukraine still controls there would be a small concession in practical terms, but would be symbolically significant for Kyiv because it would constitute an acceptance of the Donbas being Russian.
Zelensky has previously spoken of retaking Russian-controlled territory in four of Ukraine's regions, as well as the Crimean peninsula, which Moscow annexed in 2014.

US tech giant Microsoft says it has fixed problems that led to a global outage of its services. The glitch severely disrupted online communications in businesses and governments for more than 24 hours.
The US technology conglomerate Microsoft said on Saturday that a more than 24-hour global outage affecting its Microsoft 365 applications used by businesses and governments across the world has now ended.
"We ​have completed our efforts to address ​the underlying issue of the ⁠incident ​and ​restored service to ​the remaining impacted ‌customers and regions," ​the ⁠company posted on X.
Microsoft applications such as Teams, Outlook and Copilot were all hit by the outage, leading to communications problems in scores of countries.
The company has said it was "not aware" of any outside interference that could have been behind the outage, blaming the problem on server issues.
The disruption was one of the longest in Microsoft's history and the second this year.
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
The outage, which began around 1725 UTC on Thursday according to web testing and network diagnostics company ​Ookla, affected government agencies and businesses across much of the world.
It made it impossible to carry out activities such as sending emails and holding online meetings.
Germany was no exception, with a spokesperson for its Federal Ministry for Digital Transformation and Government Modernization saying that while the outage did not have a major impact on federal government functions, it did significantly affect ​German businesses.
Britain's state health service (NHS) was also severely affected, with personnel forced to have recourse to paper records rather than those stored online.
Altogether, there were more than 7.4 million reports of problems worldwide logged by Downdetector, which monitors online outages.
The disruption highlights the widespread and perilous reliance of governments and businesses on a very small number of Big Tech companies.
Tthe problems at Microsoft are so far believed to be unconnected with the major communications outage that has affected US aviation.

Anti-corruption agency carried out searches as part of investigation into Orbán-era minister accused of taking bribes
Hungary’s anti-corruption agency said on Friday it had seized cash worth $19.5m (£14.8m) buried in forests and hidden elsewhere while investigating an ex-minister of nationalist former leader Viktor Orbán’s cabinet.
Miklós Seszták, Hungary’s minister of national development between 2014 and 2018, is accused of taking bribes in a scheme involving the state transport company, purchasing secondhand buses at inflated prices.
The prime minister, Péter Magyar , won a landslide election victory in April, ending Orbán’s 16 years in power after promising to investigate alleged corruption and abuse of office during his rival’s rule.
Seszták, two other Orbán-era ministers and the former premier’s brother have been taken into custody in different cases as graft inquiries have gathered pace in recent weeks.
The National Asset Recovery and Protection Office (NVVH), an anti-graft body with sweeping powers established as part of Magyar’s accountability drive, said it searched several locations on Thursday and Friday as part of the criminal proceedings against Seszták.
“During the search, investigators found large amounts of cash: buried in forests, hidden in agricultural and warehouse buildings as well as residential properties, and stored in high-value safes in secluded locations,” the statement said.
“The total amount of cash found during the two-day search was 5,071,632,000 forints, €2,658,350 and US $1,257,100,” it added, bringing the combined value to $19.5m.
NVVH said its staff deposited the cash into the Hungarian State Treasury’s account.
“Upon receipt, 12 Treasury employees spent 8 hours counting the money using 5 counting machines,” the finance minister, András Kármán, said on Facebook.
“This officially marks the end of the Fidesz-KDNP mafia!” he said in reference to Orbán’s former governing coalition.
The former leader did not react to the latest development. Orbán had previously denounced the probes targeting his inner circle as “political persecution” aimed at imprisoning him.

An ex-minister faces a bribery probe as Hungary’s new government investigates alleged corruption during former Prime Minister Viktor Orban’s rule.
Hungarian investigators have found $19.5m in hidden cash, including bundles dug out in forests, during a corruption probe involving a former minister under ex-Prime Minister Viktor Orban.
The National Asset Recovery and Protection Office, a new agency set up to investigate suspected misuse of public money, said in a statement late on Friday that searches took place on November 12 and 13 in Budapest and three other parts of Hungary.
Its investigators found Hungarian forints, euros and US dollars in farm buildings, warehouses, a home and “a high-value safe in a secluded location”, as well as beneath the ground in forests. The agency released footage showing officers digging outdoors after dark and examining piles of cash, which was later deposited with the state treasury.
Finance Minister Andras Karman said on Facebook on Friday that 12 treasury employees spent eight hours counting it.
The discovery comes amid an investigation into Miklos Sesztak, Hungary’s development minister from 2014 to 2018, who is suspected of receiving more than $37.2m in bribes and kickbacks tied to overpriced secondhand bus purchases by a state transport company and government construction projects.
Prime Minister Peter Magyar, whose centre-right, pro-European Tisza party ended Orban’s 16 years in power in April, said on Facebook on Friday that the recovery signalled the end of what he called the “Fidesz-KDNP mafia”.
Fidesz is Orban’s right-wing party, while KDNP, the Christian Democratic People’s Party, was its smaller governing ally.
Orban has previously accused the new government of using the investigations to force him out of politics.
Other former ministers have been arrested in separate cases, as has Gyorgy Matolcsy, the former governor of Hungary’s central bank, which sets monetary policy.
His case concerns alleged misuse of public assets held by a central bank foundation. Matolcsy has denied wrongdoing.
A survey published this week by Hungarian news website HVG by pollster Median suggested that 70 percent of respondents considered investigating suspected corruption under Orban and holding those responsible accountable very important.

Germany cruised to a 3-1 win against Serbia in Belgrade on Friday, setting up a crunch encounter with the Netherlands in Berlin on Monday to decide who tops Group A2.
In teeming rain in an almost empty stadium, the Germans forced Serbia’s Srdan Babic into an early own goal with Florian Wirtz and debutant Brajan Gruda also scoring.
Babic made up for his blunder with a second-half consolation strike, while Serbia finished with nine men after substitutes Vanja Dragojevic and Andrija Zivkovic were sent off late on.
Germany have now won twice, drawn twice and lost once in five games under coach Jürgen Klopp, who was optimistic the side were beginning to take shape under his tutelage.
“We played a truly fantastic game. I think we need to get a bit more used to the fact that we’re genuinely good – and capable of being very, very good,” Klopp told RTL. “Our counter-pressing was superb and the intensity was top-notch. So, from my point of view, it was a really, really good game.
“We wanted to qualify for that ‘final’ in Berlin, and now we have … It’s great. We’re looking forward to it, and we have a wealth of options to choose from.”
The Netherlands ’ 7-0 annihilation of Greece in Amsterdam means the Germans will probably need to win on Monday to reach the quarter-finals, unless Serbia beat the Greeks away from home.

Tolu Arokodare has scored 13 goals in 17 appearances this season after joining Ajax on loan from Wolves
Tolu Arokodare was the hero as Nigeria boosted their hopes of reaching the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) with a 3-1 home win over tournament co-hosts Tanzania.
With the East Africans already assured of a spot at the finals, the Super Eagles are battling for the one qualification spot available in Group L and have little margin for error after losing 3-0 in Guinea-Bissau in September.
Alhassan Yusuf kept his composure to slot Nigeria into a second-minute lead in Uyo from Ademola Lookman's pass, but the visitors equalised through Alphonce Msanga just after the half-hour mark.
Arokodare climbed off the bench at half-time and cleverly flicked home Wilfred Ndidi's low ball to restore the lead for the West Africans in the 52nd minute.
And the Ajax striker, who is on a season-long loan from Wolves, gave the Super Eagles breathing space eight minutes later when he controlled Moses Usor's cross from the left and smashed in from 12 yards out.
With three games played in the group, Eric Chelle's side are now one point behind leaders Guinea-Bissau, who drew 1-1 with Madagascar on Thursday.
Elsewhere, Mohamed Salah scored twice late on against Malawi as Egypt cruised to a 5-0 victory in Ali Maher's first match in charge.
Achraf Hakimi netted two stunning goals and Yassine Bounou saved a penalty to help Morocco continue their unbeaten start with a 5-1 win over Niger.
Meanwhile, Tunisia are in danger of missing out on the finals for the first time since 1992 after suffering a 2-0 defeat at home against Libya, and Kenya scored a last-minute equaliser to end South Africa's perfect start.
The third round of qualifying culminates with three games on Saturday, while the fourth round of fixtures are split across Monday and Tuesday.
The most recent of Egypt's record seven Afcon titles came in 2010, and Mohamed Salah (right) has finished as a runner-up twice with the Pharaohs since then
Egypt reached the semi-finals of Afcon 2025 and the last 16 of this year's Fifa World Cup under Hossam Hassan but parted company with the 60-year-old earlier this month.
The Pharaohs had taken four points from their opening two games in Group B, with Salah substituted after an hour in their 0-0 draw with Angola before missing the win in South Sudan.
The former Liverpool forward returned as captain against Malawi, and Egypt cruised into a 3-0 lead at the break through goals from Nasser Maher, Omar Marmoush and Mohamed Hany.
Salah got on the scoresheet when he stooped to head in a cross from the left and rounded off proceedings by dinking in a penalty after Hamza Abdelkarim was tripped in the box.
Victory in Maher's first game at the helm puts Egypt three points clear of Angola, who take on South Sudan on Saturday.
In Group A, Morocco had also looked like they would ease to three points against Niger in Casablanca after Yassir Zabiri's early effort and a brilliant long-range strike from right-back Hakimi put them 2-0 up after 27 minutes.
But Mohamed Abdourahmane headed in to halve the deficit and Niger had a chance to level from the spot on the stroke of half-time after a handball by Noussair Mazraoui.
However, Atlas Lions goalkeeper Bounou moved to his left to keep out Youssouf Oumarou's penalty, and Hakimi made it 3-1 in first-half stoppage time with a dipping free-kick from distance.
Youssef En-Nesyri steered in the fourth in the 77th minute from a Hakimi pass and Ayoub Oufkir completed the scoring from close range in the final minute.
Earlier in Group A on Friday Gabon beat Lesotho to move on to six points thanks to two second-half goals from Denis Bouanga.
The LA FC forward smashed the right-hand upright with a penalty but broke the deadlock with a header a minute later and then scored from 12 yards when the Panthers were awarded a second spot kick.
Former South Africa international Benni McCarthy denied Bafana Bafana victory as his Kenya side grabbed a late equaliser
Tunisia have appeared at a record 17 consecutive Afcons but are winless and bottom of Group H - another section with just one qualifying place on offer - after defeat by their North African neighbours Libya.
The Carthage Eagles could complain about refereeing decisions going against them in Sfax, with Ali Maaloul penalised for a shirt pull on Muad Eisay just before half-time and Ali Youssef converting the resulting spot-kick.
Tunisia had a goal ruled out following a marginal offside call in the second half and three minutes later a low shot from Hamdou El Houni made it 2-0 to the Mediterranean Knights.
Libya, who last played at an Afcon in 2012, climb to second in the table and go level on points with Uganda.
South Africa are a point clear of Guinea at the top of Group D after a 2-2 draw against Benni McCarthy's Kenya in Johannesburg.
Amos Wanjala's own goal gifted the hosts an early lead before Michael Olunga levelled from the penalty spot just before half-time.
Relebohile Mofokeng restored Bafana Bafana's advantage with 13 minutes remaining, but Kenya claimed a point when Ryan Ogam's low shot from 20 yards crept inside the left-hand upright in the 90th minute.
Elsewhere, Burkina Faso joined Benin on seven points at the top of Group F thanks to Elohim Kabore's 94th-minute winner against Mauritania in Ouagadougou.
Mali extended their winning start to go top of Group K after Mamadou Camara completed a 3-2 comeback win at home against Rwanda, who had led twice in Bamako.
Rwanda had won their first two fixtures and are three points ahead of Cape Verde , who registered their first points with a 4-2 victory over Liberia in Praia.
Ethiopia registered their first win to upset Mozambique in Maputo, with Kenean Markneh scoring the only goal in the 87th minute after Mambas keeper Ernan spilled a low shot from Carlos Damtew.
The East Africans move on to three points but remain bottom of Group J, behind Sudan on head-to-head record, while Mozambique are on four points and three behind leaders Senegal.
Zambia moved level on four points with Group I leaders Algeria after a 1-1 draw at home to Burundi. The North Africans have the chance to open up a three-point gap when they host Togo on Saturday.
In Group G, Comoros were held to a goalless draw by Congo-Brazzaville in Moroni. Cameroon lead the section on seven points, with Comoros on four, Namibia on three and the Congolese bottom on two points.

Mohamed Salah scored twice in Egypt’s 5-0 thrashing of Malawi in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers on Friday, becoming the country’s leading all-time scorer with 70 goals.
The 34-year-old former Liverpool star left it late in Cairo to overtake Hossam Hassan, scoring with a far-post header in the 84th minute and from a penalty five minutes into added time.
Hassan was fired as Egypt coach last week, and replacement Ali Maher made a perfect start with goals from Nasser Maher, Omar Marmoush and Mohamed Hany building a 3-0 lead by half-time.
Egypt have seven points in Group B after three matches, three more than Angola, who host South Sudan on Saturday.
Achraf Hakimi, favourite to win a second successive African Footballer of the Year award next month, also bagged a brace as Group A pacesetters Morocco crushed Niger 5-1 in Casablanca.
Substitute Tolu Arokodaro scored twice within eight minutes as Nigeria beat Tanzania 3-1 in Uyo to get their campaign back on track.
Tunisia suffered a shock home 2-0 loss to Libya, and Kenya scored in the final minute to snatch a surprise 2-2 draw away to South Africa.
Alhassan Yusuf put Nigeria ahead after just 103 seconds and Alphonce Msanga equalised on 32 minutes following a rare Tanzanian attack.
Arokodaro, scorer of six goals in his last five matches for Ajax Amsterdam, came off the bench for the second half and quickly made an impact.
His near-post back heel off a low cross put Nigeria ahead for the second time after 52 minutes, and as the match reached the hour mark, he struck again from close range.
An ultimately comfortable victory lifted the Super Eagles to six points after three rounds in Group L, one point behind Guinea-Bissau, who drew 1-1 with Madagascar on Thursday.
Although bottom of the table with just one point, Tanzania are guaranteed a place at the 2027 AFCON as cohosts with Kenya and Uganda.
That means Guinea-Bissau, Nigeria and Madagascar must fight for one place at the 24-nation tournament, the first to be staged in East Africa since Ethiopia were the 1976 hosts.
Nigeria were in trouble after a 3-0 hammering in Guinea-Bissau two months ago, but now have a clear path to a tournament they have won three times.
Away wins over Tanzania on Tuesday and Madagascar in March, and a home win over Guinea-Bissau, also in March, will assure qualification.
Tunisia are in Group H, which includes cohosts and automatic qualifiers Uganda, and their record of reaching every AFCON tournament since 1994 is in peril.
A 2-0 defeat at home to neighbours Libya leaves them bottom of the table with just two points, and a venue switch two months ago means their remaining three fixtures are all away.
Ali Youssef converted a 44th-minute penalty for Libya, and Hamdou Elhouni, who once played for leading Tunisian club Esperance, doubled the lead in the 62nd minute.
Victory lifted Libya from last place to a share of the lead on four points with Uganda. Botswana and Tunisia have two each. Uganda host Botswana in Kampala on Saturday.
The Group D clash between South Africa and Kenya pitted two South African coaches against each other. Pitso Mosimane handles Bafana Bafana and Benni McCarthy guides the Harambee Stars.
Former Manchester United coaching staffer McCarthy was the happier at full-time after Ryan Ogam equalised in the final minute of regular time.
From a South African perspective, this was two points lost, although they remain on top with seven. Guinea have six, automatic qualifiers; Kenya, two; and Eritrea, one.

Germany took a third-minute lead through an own goal, and Florian Wirtz added a second 11 minutes later. Brajan Gruda scored on his debut five minutes after the ⁠break before Srdan Babic pulled one back for Serbia, who finished the game with nine men.
The Netherlands are top of the standings on 11 points, and Germany moved level on eight points with Greece to leave the three sides battling it out for two quarterfinal places on Monday. Germany will host the Netherlands in Berlin while Greece host a Serbian side that has lost all five fixtures.
Greece and the Netherlands both came into the game unbeaten, but ‌the Dutch destroyed the visitors in a devastating display of attacking prowess.
The opening goal came after Greece lost possession close to their own area, before a poorly controlled ball by defender Konstantinos Mavropanos fell to Summerville and he slipped his shot past the keeper.
Joey Veerman threaded a pass through to Reijnders, whose strike found the roof of the net from the edge of the six-yard area in the 12th minute, and six minutes later he finished off Malen’s pass across goal.
Reijnders completed his hat-trick with a simple tap-in after Denzel Dumfries nodded the ball down in the six-yard box, and Timber netted from close range with Malen providing another assist.
Timber’s second came after Dumfries’ cross was pushed ⁠away by the keeper, and Malen got his well-deserved goal following some neat skill and a lay-off from ⁠Dumfries.
Jurgen Klopp had a difficult start to life as Germany’s manager , winning just one of his opening four games, also against Serbia.
Klopp had used his first international window to experiment with a 44-man roster split into two separate squads, but his chosen 11 put in a dominant display under heavy rain in Belgrade, especially in the ⁠opening half.
Germany went in front after a Kai Havertz header went in off Babic, and when Havertz had a shot parried away by keeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, Wirtz was there to convert the rebound.
Klopp’s side missed chances to ⁠finish off the game in the first half but looked well in control after Gruda’s ⁠solo goal.
Gruda collected Joshua Kimmich’s pass inside his own half, drove forward largely unopposed and drilled a low shot into the far corner from outside the area.
Babic’s goal gave Serbia hope, while Germany continued to attack. Kimmich had a goal ruled out for offside, and Derry Scherhant hit the post before Vanja Dragojevic’s red card in the 74th minute. Serbia had ‌another substitute, Andrija Zivkovic, sent off late on.
In Group B1, Switzerland earned promotion to League A thanks to a 0-0 draw in Slovenia, while Scotland earned a 2-1 win over North Macedonia thanks to a John McGinn double. Scotland captain Andy Robertson made a record-equalling 102nd ‌appearance, ‌drawing level with Kenny Dalglish.
Slovakia were held to a 2-2 draw at home by the Faroe Islands in Group C3, but the point was enough for the hosts to clinch promotion.
Iceland romped to a 5-0 win in Bulgaria to remain top of Group C4, with Andri Gudjohnsen providing a hat-trick.

The vote, first expected in 2022, will now be held on February 11, according to the country’s election commission.
South Sudan has delayed its first-ever presidential and parliamentary elections until February, the latest in a series of delays to the long-sought vote, as ethnic and political tensions deepen.
The country’s election commission announced on Saturday that the polls would be held on February 11 next year, instead of December 22 this year. It did not give any reason for the decision.
The world’s youngest country, which continues to grapple with violence despite a 2018 peace deal that ended five years of civil war, has delayed the vote at least three times since setting 2022 as its election year.
In September, South Sudan’s President Salva Kiir dissolved the transitional unity government and appointed a caretaker administration. That step allowed the country to move towards elections without first completing a permanent constitution or census – two processes that were previously tied to the transition.
But analysts and watchdogs warned that move dismantled a key power-sharing arrangement, consolidating power in Kiir’s hands and raising the risk of renewed widespread conflict.
“This amounts to a constitutional coup through legislative reforms,” Yasmin Sooka, chair of the United Nations Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan, said in October.
“Whether elections take place or not, South Sudan will still need an inclusive political settlement, protection for civilians and institutions capable of preventing further violence,” she added.
Kiir’s government forces and followers of detained former Vice President Riek Machar have been involved in escalating, deadly confrontations in recent months.
Other ethnic tensions and cattle-rustling battles have also complicated the picture in one of the world’s poorest countries.
South Sudan became independent from Sudan in 2011, but Kiir’s and Machar’s forces fought a civil war from 2013 to 2018 that killed at least 400,000 people.
Machar has been under house arrest since last March, accused of crimes against humanity.
Under the new election timetable, voter registration is due to begin on Saturday, November 14 and continue until November 28.
A 45-day election campaign period will run from December 27 to February 9, followed by a one-day silence period before the February 11 poll.
Gabriel Bol Deng, chairman of the National Elections Commission, said a total of 3,161 registration centres have been set up across the country, with more than 22,000 staff recruited for the operation.
According to the World Bank, about 90 percent of South Sudan’s 15 million inhabitants have no state-recognised identification, complicating their registration.
Such people, particularly in rural areas, will be identified by community leaders and issued an “identification form” enabling them to vote, Deng said.

Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel died after a collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper Jesus Owono; the Spanish Football Federation's disciplinary committee has imposed the maximum punishment; the 2-2 scoreline will stand after the game was abandoned seven minutes into stoppage time
FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been suspended for 12 matches for his challenge of "excessive force" which resulted in the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.
The 25-year-old was sent off after colliding with De Miguel late in the Segunda Division game earlier this month. De Miguel died the following day .
After a review of the incident the Spanish Football Federation's disciplinary committee imposed the maximum punishment on the Equatorial Guinea international.
"The assessment of the conduct under consideration in these proceedings must be based on the facts expressly recorded in the referee's report, which states that the player was sent off for 'violently striking an opponent in the chest with his leg, using excessive force, while the ball was in play'," said the committee's statement.
"The tragic outcome of the incident, resulting in the death of Jesus de Miguel, is public knowledge. In view of the nature of the conduct described and the accompanying circumstances-the maximum sanction, 12 matches of suspension, is justified."
The federation has also decided the 2-2 scoreline will stand after the game was abandoned seven minutes into stoppage time.
"This avoids having to resume play from the precise moment at which the tragic incident occurred-the most respectful course of action, given the extraordinary and tragic circumstances of this case," it said.
Andorra manager Carles Manso said on Thursday that Owono is still yet to decide if he will return to football.
Previously Owono released a statement expressing his "enormous pain" at De Miguel's death and saying he "will face whatever comes with the utmost respect".
Spanish police have opened an investigation into possible involuntary manslaughter, which is standard practice under Spanish law.

SpaceX had planned to catch and later reuse both stages of its biggest rocket for the first time. But the booster exploded over the Gulf of Mexico, while the spacecraft continued into orbit.
US company SpaceX has successfully launched the latest flight of its Starship spacecraft into orbit but did not recover the booster rocket as planned.
The company, owned by tech billionaire Elon Musk , is hoping to develop a fully reusable rocket system. It had planned to recover both the booster and the upper stage, which is the spacecraft itself.
Instead of landing back at the launch site, the booster exploded above the Gulf of Mexico. The upper stage is currently in orbit and the plan is to recover it on Saturday when it returns to Earth.
It is to be caught by mechanical arms upon landing back at the launch pad, marking the first time the spacecraft would be caught after returning to Earth. It could then potentially be reused in the future.
In addition to testing the reusable rocket system, the mission also delivered 26 of SpaceX’s satellites for its Starlink network .
SpaceX's Starship is the world's largest and most powerful rocket system. At 124 meters (407 feet) tall, it consists of a spacecraft mounted on a booster rocket. Both stages were designed from the outset to be fully reusable.
At the launch, both the spacecraft and booster successfully lifted off from the SpaceX South Texas Starbase site. While the Friday launch was an uncrewed mission, Starship is designed to carry both crew and cargo.
On its return path, the booster diverted from its flight path to the launch site and steered to a designated area over the Gulf of Mexico where it exploded over the sea surface. The reasons for the failure of the controlled landing were not immediately clear.
"Not sure right now why we weren't able to bring it back," SpaceX's Dan Huot said.
The upper stage continued into orbit and soon after began releasing the 26 satellites it was carrying.
Developing a fully reusable rocket system is key to SpaceX’s goal to drive down the cost of spaceflight.
In previous launches, the Starship booster was successfully recovered. The upper stages of the 14 previous Starship missions have all ended up in the ocean though, either by design or because of failures .
The new objective of Friday’s launch was to recover both stages of the Starship launch system.
Currently, SpaceX is mostly using smaller Falcon rockets, which are not fully reusable because the second stage cannot be recovered.
Musk said he expected SpaceX to conduct Starship launches once a week by early 2027.
The project has received billions of dollars in NASA funding, with SpaceX also investing at least $15 billion.
The main goal of the program is to put astronauts on the Moon by 2028 although outstanding technical challenges could delay that schedule.

2002 yılında çıkardığı "Let Go" albümüyle müzik dünyasında fırtınalar estiren ve 2000'lerin pop-punk sahnesinin en ikonik isimlerinden biri haline gelen Avril Lavigne, anne olduğu müjdesiyle magazin gündemine bomba gibi düştü.
Ünlü şarkıcı, 13 Kasım tarihinde Instagram hesabında yayımladığı duygusal bir gönderiyle kız bebeğinin dünyaya geldiğini takipçileriyle paylaştı.
Paylaşımında bebeğini "minik prensesimiz" sözleriyle tanımlayan Lavigne, yeni doğan bebeğinin elini tuttuğu ve onu kucağında sarıldığı karelere yer verdi.
Şarkıcının hamilelik sürecini daha önce hiç paylaşmamış olması ise hayranları için büyük bir sürpriz oldu.

Paylaşımında bebeğinin adına, kesin doğum tarihine ve babasının kim olduğuna dair herhangi bir bilgiye yer vermeyen ünlü yıldızın şu an resmi olarak kiminle birlikte olduğu da bilinmiyor.
Sanatçının bu gizemli tutumu hayranları arasında büyük bir merak uyandırırken, sosyal medyada tebrik mesajları yağdı.

Country music superstar Garth Brooks will perform a multi-city tour of Ireland in 2027
Fans of Garth Brooks will be brushing off their Stetsons and polishing their cowboy boots after the country music superstar announced he will be performing in multiple cities across Ireland in 2027.
The tour includes Belfast, Galway, Kilkenny, Limerick and Cork and will be the first time he has played in Northern Ireland since his King's Hall gig in November 1998.
The singer has said in the past that Ireland is his favourite place in the world to sing , and the love appears to be mutual as his first two Belfast concerts sold out, with an extra date already added.
So why has an American country music star remained so popular with Irish fans for so many years?
Cathy O'Reilly previously saw Garth Brooks live at two of his Dublin concerts in 2022
Cathy O'Reilly, who is originally from County Monaghan but lives in Belfast, managed to get her tickets for the very first show of Garth Brooks' tour on 21 May 2027 at Boucher Road Playing Fields.
She has already seen Brooks perform live before - twice during his run of concerts in Dublin in 2022 and her love of his music was passed on from her parents and uncles.
"It's growing up listening to him it brings me back to my childhood. My uncle gave me his cd, he didn't even buy me one - just gave me his because I loved him so much."
She believes the Irish link to the US and the fact that fans on the island give the best welcome to performers, are the reasons for Garth Brooks' popularity in Ireland.
"He [Garth Brooks] gives us energy and we're giving it back ten-fold nearly, and we're just so welcoming so he really enjoys coming here."
Peter Aiken, from Aiken Promotions, told Irish broadcaster RTÉ that the new Belfast gig is "red hot".
Brooks is the biggest selling artist in US history and is the only artist to pass 200 million albums sold.
In 2014 about 400,000 fans booked tickets to five concerts he had planned for Dublin's Croke Park but Dublin City Council only granted permission for three of them.
Brooks said he would only perform all five concerts or none at all and so the shows were cancelled.
Stephen Butler performs as a Garth Brooks tribute act with the band Thunder Rolls and described his job as "easy" due to the love of Garth Brooks' fans
Stephen Butler from Newtownabbey performs as a Garth Brooks' tribute act with the band Thunder Rolls.
"My mother was a fan when I was younger, she was always playing his music and buying his albums so I loved the songs.
"I knew, with me loving Garth and there being such a following in Ireland, I knew it was the right thing to do."
He went to the Dublin concert in 2022 and while he hasn't yet got tickets for the Ireland dates next year, he hopes to get tickets to at least one of them closer to the time.
Butler said in order to embody the stage persona of Garth Brooks, you "have to be passionate about his music"
"I was able to get four or five tickets about a week or two before the Croke Park shows, I'll definitely go - I have to go.
"His band is amazing, he's amazing, and his songs - he's got an endless amount of anthems."
Butler said in order to embody the stage persona of Garth Brooks, you "have to be passionate about his music".
"I'm not saying I'm as good as Garth Brooks, but I definitely have his enthusiasm.
"I talk about him and how much I love him throughout the songs and I just identify with them as much as I can.
"My job is easy, I just have to go on there and get everybody singing along with me."
Butler says he thinks the reason Garth Brooks remains so enduringly popular in Ireland is because the people here identify so strongly with his songs.
"Everybody loves Friends In Low Places, people of Ireland love it, they love Callin' Baton Rouge.
"I speak to a lot of people after I play the shows and a lot of people identify with some of the words in the songs, they tell me about a relative that's passed and they seem to have some kind of identification with the songs Tomorrow Never Comes or Unanswered Prayers - it talks about love and about how Garth feels.
"And in amongst Thunder Rolls and the big hits that Garth has, he sings big rocky country rock and ballads, so it's exciting and it's sad - it's an emotional roller coaster," he said.
"And he's such a down-to-earth, genuine, caring person, he seems to be a good soul and I think people people identify with his personality.
"It's a big working-class country and they love someone that's genuine and that talks from the heart."

Bursa'nın Nilüfer ilçesinde yaşayan Yiğit Kiremitçi, 25 yaşında bireysel olarak başladığı oyuncak koleksiyonuna, evlendikten sonra eşi Derya ile biriktirmeye devam etti. Yıllar içinde büyüyen koleksiyon, 2023 yılında açılan üç katlı Bursa Oyuncak Müzesi’nde sergilenmeye başlandı.
22 yıllık koleksiyon çalışmasının ürünü olan müze, 1800’lü yıllardan günümüze uzanan geniş oyuncak çeşitliliği ile ziyaretçilerini zaman yolculuğuna çıkarıyor.
Türkiye’de üretilenlerin yanı sıra Almanya, ABD, Fransa ve İngiltere gibi farklı ülkelerden gelen çeşitlerinin de bulunduğu 4 bin 500 oyuncaklı müzede ziyaretçiler, rehber eşliğinde oyuncakların tarih ve hikayeleri hakkında da bilgi sahibi oluyor.
Koleksiyonun detaylarını anlatan Kiremitçi, “Müzede 40 yaşından 200 yaşına kadar, dünyanın her yerinden 4 bin 500'e yakın oyuncak var. Koleksiyonumuz sürekli gelişiyor ve değişiyor. Bu durum ziyaretçilerimize bir kez geldikten sonra tekrar gelip yeni oyuncakları görme fırsatı doğuruyor” diye konuştu.
Kiremitçi, “22 yıla yakın uzun soluklu bu çalışmada, Türk oyuncakları dışında ciddi bir yabancı oyuncak koleksiyonu toplamak büyük emek gerektirdi. Almanya, ABD, Fransa ve İngiltere'den çeşitli oyuncaklar getirip sergilemeye devam ediyoruz" dedi.
Koleksiyoner sayısı arttığı için her geçen gün eski ve artık üretilmeyen antik oyuncaklara ulaşmak zorlaştığını söyleyen Kiremitçi, “Bu nedenle zamanında alıp müzemize koyduğumuz birçok parça için 'iyi ki almışız, iyi ki sergiliyoruz' diyebiliyorum” diye konuştu.
Müzedeki nadir parçaların hikayelerine değinen Kiremitçi, "Bir oyuncağın rengi, dönemi, markası ve ülkesi onu özgün kılabiliyor. Almanya'dan bulup getirdiğimiz, hikayesi olan yaklaşık 150 yıllık Fransız ‘Jume’ bebeklerimiz var. Onun dışında Türk oyuncaklarında da birçok müzede olmayan, sadece bizde bulunan Nekur, Gürel ve Alasya oyuncakları yer alıyor. Nekur vitrinindeki kahverengi polis otosu, mavi pikaplar gibi oyuncakları bir tek, Bursa Oyuncak Müzesi'nde görebilirsiniz. Çatı katında ise çeşitli bisikletler, bir sınıfımız, Fatoş oyuncakları, telli arabalar ile Alman, Japon ve Amerikan yapımı uzay dönemi oyuncakları bulunuyor" dedi.
Oyuncak dünyasının insanlık tarihiyle paralellik gösteren ve dünya genelindeki olaylardan etkilenen bir endüstri olduğunu söyleyen Kiremitçi, “1950'lerin oyuncaklarıyla 1990'ların oyuncakları arasında ciddi farklar görebilirsiniz. Uzay odasına gittiğinizde, Ay'a ilk ayak basma rekabetinin oyuncaklara yansıdığını ya da İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında Japon oyuncak firmalarının eski silah fabrikalarında kurulduğunu görebiliyorsunuz” dedi.
Ziyaretçilerden de bahseden Kiremitçi "Gözü yaşlı yolcu ettiğimiz ziyaretçilerimiz oluyor. Adı Oyuncak Müzesi olan bir yerin sadece çocuklarla ilgili olduğu düşünülüyor. Halbuki buradaki oyuncaklar çocukların değil, yetişkinlerin oyuncakları. Anneler, babalar, anneanneler, babaanneler ve dedeler buraya geldiklerinde kendi çocukluk oyuncaklarını bulup geçmişe yolculuk yapıyor, büyük bir sürprizle karşılaşıyorlar. En mutlu olduğumuz anlar, ziyaretçilerin kendi çocukluk anılarını yaşadığı bu anlar" diye konuştu.
Müze görevlisi Rezan Efendioğlu, “200 yaşından 40 yaşına kadar farklı zaman aralıklarında üretilmiş 4 bin 500’den fazla oyuncağımız var. 200 yaşında bir oyuncağımız var ve üst gövdesi demir, alt kısmı ise kumaşın içine saman doldurulmuş bir şekilde yapılmış. Bu ve benzeri bebekler, müzenin en eski oyuncakları olarak dikkat çekiyor. Ayrıca başka müzelerde göremeyeceğiniz çok nadir parçalarımız da mevcut” dedi.

Başlangıçta pek önemsemediğimiz bu küçük değişiklikler, özellikle 40’lı yaşlardan sonra günlük hayatın bir parçası haline gelebiliyor. Zamanla kitap okumak için gözlük aramaya, bilgisayar başında farklı bir gözlüğe ihtiyaç duymaya başlıyoruz. Bunun temel nedenlerinden biri, gözümüzün doğal lensinin yaşla birlikte esnekliğini kaybetmesi. Yakın görme güçlüğü olarak bilinen bu durum, yaş almanın doğal bir parçası olsa da gözlüğe duyulan ihtiyacı artırabiliyor. Bugün ise göz içi lens teknolojileri sayesinde uygun hastalarda gözlüğe olan bağımlılığı azaltmaya yönelik farklı seçenekler bulunuyor. Bunlardan biri de uzun süreli kullanım özelliğiyle dikkat çeken ömürlük lens.
Ömürlük lens, gözün doğal lensinin yerine cerrahi yöntemle yerleştirilen ve uzun yıllar göz içinde kalmak üzere tasarlanan yapay göz içi lenstir. Kontakt lenslerden farklı olarak her gün takılıp çıkarılması, temizlenmesi veya düzenli aralıklarla yenilenmesi gerekmez. Uygun hastalarda kullanılan çok odaklı göz içi lenslerle yakın, orta ve uzak mesafelerde gözlüğe duyulan ihtiyacın azaltılması hedeflenebilir. Telefon kullanmak, kitap okumak, bilgisayarda çalışmak veya uzaktaki bir tabelayı görmek gibi günlük aktivitelerde daha az gözlük ihtiyacı, yaşam konforunu destekleyebilir.
Gözlük kullanan kişiler yıllar içinde değişen numaralar, yeni camlar, çerçeveler ve farklı mesafeler için gözlük ihtiyaçları nedeniyle tekrarlayan harcamalarla karşılaşabiliyor. Ömürlük lensin uzun süre göz içinde kalması ve olağan koşullarda rutin değişim gerektirmemesi, uzun vadeli kullanım açısından önemli bir özellik. Gözlüğe duyulan ihtiyacın azalması, bazı kişilerde tekrarlayan gözlük harcamalarını da azaltabilir. Ancak cerrahi maliyetler ve kişisel ihtiyaçlar nedeniyle herkes için ekonomik avantaj sağlanacağı söylenemez.
Göz içi lens uygulamaları en sık katarakt ameliyatlarıyla gündeme geliyor. Katarakt, gözün doğal lensinin saydamlığını kaybetmesiyle ortaya çıkıyor. Ameliyatta bu lens çıkarılarak yerine yapay göz içi lens yerleştiriliyor. Bununla birlikte kataraktı bulunmayan, yaşa bağlı yakın görme güçlüğü yaşayan bazı uygun hastalarda da doğal lens değişimi değerlendirilebiliyor. Bu karar verilirken kişinin yaşı, kornea ve retina sağlığı, günlük yaşam alışkanlıkları ve görme beklentileri birlikte inceleniyor. Burada önemsenen konu, yalnızca gözlük ihtiyacının azalması değil, kişinin günlük yaşamına uygun bir görme planlaması yapılmasıdır. Ömürlük lensin uzun süreli kullanım özelliği, ömür boyu kusursuz veya tamamen gözlüksüz görme garantisi anlamına gelmez. Bazı aktivitelerde gözlük ihtiyacı devam edebilir. Badalan, Kuzey Ege mutfağında sonbaharın sonunun habercisidir. Abimin “Size kaç kilo söyleyeyim” diye aramasıyla gelir bizim mutfağa. Önceki hafta “10 kilo” deyip buzluk tedarikimi sağladım ama aklımda hep aynı soru: Bu güzel sebzeyi neden layıkıyla tanıtamıyoruz? Lezzetli Hayat ’ın birkaç gündem toplantısında konuştuk hatta, ismiyle bayağı akılda kalıcı ama tarif etmekle olmuyor. Yöresel bir ürünün gastronomik bir değere dönüşmesi için ev mutfağından çıkması, lokantalara, restoranlara girmesi ve şeflere ilham vermesi gerekiyor.
Geçen hafta, eski arkadaşlarımla bir öğle yemeği için Yalova Restoran’da buluştuk. Yalova 1940’lardan beri Çanakkale’nin simge gastronomi noktası; okurlarımız arasında gitmeyen varsa da duymayan yok gibidir. Uzun akşam yemekleri için tercih edilen ve deniz ürünleriyle, mezeleriyle dillere destan bir restoranda ‘öğlen, esnaf işi, sıcak tencere yemeği’ çıkarma geleneğinin de o yıllardan beri devam ettiğini, çağıran dostumun “Badalan günleri başlamış Yalova’da” demesiyle öğrendim. Madem bu pek az kişinin bildiği ‘tatlı’ sebze şef restoranlarına da girdi, yazılma-anlatılma zamanı gelmiştir artık.
Badalan kısaca ‘taze’ kuru fasulyedir. Yani hasat edildikten sonra kurutulup kılıfından sıyrılarak tanelenen kuru fasulyeyi kurutmuyor, hafif-kuru dış kılıfıyla beraber hasat ediyorlar (taze barbunya gibi düşünün). Bazı kaynaklarda İspir kuru fasulyesinin taze hali diye geçse de aslında karakteristik bir yerel cins. İspir gibi yuvarlağa yakın tombul taneli. Belki bu yüzden karıştırılıyor. En çok nerelerde yetişir derseniz, haritamız bizi doğrudan Çanakkale’de Saraycık, Dümrek gibi merkez köylere, Yenice ve Bayramiç’e; Balıkesir’in Dursunbey ve Balya ilçelerine götürüyor. Yani aslında Kaz Dağları’nın eteklerine... Tarım müdürlüklerinin yerel üretimi geliştirme projelerinde öncelik verdikleri bir ürünmüş; özellikle Dursunbey’de 800 metre ve üzeri rakımlarda, haziranda ekilip eylül-ekim aylarında hasat ediliyor. Katma değeri yüksek, kuru fasulyeden daha kazançlı çiftçi için. Gurmeler için de öyle çünkü kuru fasulyeden daha lezzetli öncelikle. Tam kurutulmadığı için dokusu sütlü ve kremamsı. Tereyağımsı, unlu dokuyu ve hafif tatlımsı aromayı ilk kaşıkta hissedersiniz. Pişerken kabuk atmaz. Nohut ve kuru fasulye haşlarken en büyük derttir o kabukları temizlemek; özellikle humus gibi ezme yapacaksanız... Ayrıca badalan pişirirken kuru fasulyenin o yorucu ‘bir gece önceden suya koyma’ ritüeline ihtiyacınız yok. Doğrudan tencereye girebilir ve çok hızlı, 15 dakika gibi bir sürede pişer. Kurutulmuş bakliyat gibi gaz yapmaz; sindirimi de inanılmaz hafiftir.
Bana kalırsa en iyi hali az salçalı, bol domatesli-bol soğanlı ve hafif acılı. Yalova’da tam benim sevdiğim usul pişirmişler. Bir tane havuç da ekliyorum ben içine. Etsiz ve zeytinyağlısını tercih ediyoruz ama parça kuzu eti de çok yakışıyor. Bu arada tabii 15 dakikada pişebiliyor diye haldır haldır kaynatmamak lazım. Kısık ateşte usul usul pişmesi ve ardından da demlendirilmesi önemli.
Klasik tariflerin dışında humus gibi hazırlanırsa harika bir meze olarak davet sofrasında yer bulabilir. 1/1,5 su bardağı kadar badalanı 15 dakika haşlayın, 2 diş sarımsak (ağız tadınıza göre ayarlayabilirsiniz), bolca zeytinyağı, 2-3 yemek kaşığı tahin, 1/2 limonun suyu, bir fiske kimyon, biraz tuzla beraber blendırda çekin. Kremamsı kıvamını zeytinyağı miktarıyla ayarlayacaksınız, azar azar eklersiniz. İstediğiniz kıvama gelince bir tabağa yayıp üzerinde bolca karamelize soğanla servis edin. Çıtır ekmek bana bana yemeye doyamayacaksınız.
Badalanla piyaz yapabileceğiniz gibi farklı salatalarda da kullanabilirsiniz. Hayal gücünüzü kullanın. Hafif diri haşlanmış badalanları sıcakken zeytinyağı, ezilmiş sarımsak ve koruk ekşisiyle (yoksa elma sirkesi veya sumak ya da nar ekşisi) marine edin. Geniş bir kâsede hafif acımsı aromaları olan roka ya da endivyen (kıvırcık hindiba) denen Akdeniz yeşillikleri paketlerinde gördüğünüz, saçaklı kıvırcık yeşillikle harmanlayın. İlkbaharda yabani hindibayla daha da güzel olur. Üzerine dilerseniz nar taneleri, ceviz içi ve keçi peyniri (veya tulum peyniri) ufalayarak ılık servis edin.
Bu arada en mühim konuyu sona bıraktım, badalan kısa süreli hasat döneminde kabuklu şekilde satılıyor. Ben 10 kilo kadar alıyorum; ayıklayıp, yıkayıp iyice kuruladıktan sonra pişirim miktarına göre paketleyip buzluğa kaldırıyorum. Herhangi bir ön pişirmeye ihtiyacı yok. Buzluktan çıkarınca da erimesini beklemiyorum. Diğer tüm sebzelerde olduğu gibi...
Badalan İstanbul’da bazı yerel ürün pazarlarında-manavlarında var; rastladığınızda bir şans verin ya da yolunuz Çanakkale veya Balıkesir’e düşerse gördüğünüz esnaf lokantalarına bir sorun bakalım “Badalan var mıymış”... Eminim, talep gördükçe yaygınlaşacak ve dünya çapında bir gastronomik değer olarak Kaz Dağları coğrafyasına bir artı daha katacak.

Star TV'nin çok sevilen dizisi Yalı Çapkını'nda canlandırdığı Fuat Korhan karakteriyle hafızalarda yer eden Doğukan Polat, Ceyda Düvenci'nin sunumuyla NTV ekranlarında izleyiciyle buluşan “Bambaşka Sohbetler” programına konuk oldu.
Beykent Üniversitesi Oyunculuk Bölümü mezunu olan ve Kapalıçarşı dizisiyle oyunculuğa adım atan Doğukan Polat , "Nefes: Vatan Sağolsun" filmiyle tanındı.
Daha sonra birçok projede boy gösteren oyuncu, 2022-2025 yılları arasında yayınlanan Yalı Çapkını dizisinde Ferit'in ağabeyi Fuat Korhan karakterini oynadı.
Programda kariyeriyle alakalı konuşan 36 yaşındaki oyuncu, Yalı Çapkını seti için yaptığı lokma sürprinizi anlattı.
Yalı Çapkını'na 33'üncü bölümde veda eden Polat, Fuat karakteri öldükten sonra sete lokma yollamasıyla ilgili "Neşeyi, bir şeylere neşe katmayı, çarpıcı şeyler yapmayı çok seviyorum" dedi.
Oynadığı karakter öldükten sonra bir yerden ayrılmanın ve yeni bir şeye başlamanın bilinmezliğini yaşadığını söyleyen oyuncu, "Ama hayatımız devam ediyor, sanat akan bir şey başka bir yerden akarız diye düşündüm. Alışılagelmiş tepkileri de sevmediğim için ne yapalım diye düşünürken sete lokma yollayalım dedim" diye konuştu.
“Bunun üzerine herkesle hoş bir sohbet oldu, ayrılık rol için de güzel oldu. Dizinin reytingi çok yükseldi” diyen Polat, sonrasında da projeye geri döndüğünü söyledi.
Üçüncü sezonda Mert Ramazan Demir'in hayat verdiği Ferit Korhan karakterinin halüsinasyonlarında izleyici ile yeniden buluşan Doğukan Polat , "Çıktığınız kapıyı her zaman güzel kapatmak lazım. Ki tekrar içeri girebilirsiniz. O eşikten bir daha geçebilirsiniz. Orada hikayeniz bitmemiş olabilir yani" dedi.

Valilikten yapılan açıklamada, Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü tarafından yapılan uyarılarda kent genelinde, dün saat 02.00 ile bugün saat 05.00 arasında kuvvetli rüzgar ve fırtına beklendiğine ilişkin sarı kodlu meteorolojik uyarı yapıldığı hatırlatıldı.
Kentte, dün gece saatlerinden itibaren etkili olan kuvvetli rüzgar ve fırtınanın bugün de gün içerisinde etkisini sürdürmesinin beklendiği belirtilen açıklamada, şunlar kaydedildi:
"Fırtınanın etkili olmaya başladığı dün saat 02.00'den bugün saat 11.30 itibarıyla, Türkiye Afet Müdahale Planı (TAMP) kapsamında görevli 23 Afet Grubu, 39 Kaymakamlığımız ve ilgili kurumlara gerekli bilgilendirmeler yapılmıştır. Sinema tarihinin en büyük kült fenomenlerinden biri olan Star Wars, müzayede dünyasında kırılması güç bir rekora daha imza attı.
Heritage Auctions tarafından gerçekleştirilen ve iki oturumda toplamda yaklaşık 8 milyon dolarlık satış hacmine ulaşan Ultimate Star Wars Auction, franchise tarihinin en başarılı bağımsız müzayedesi olarak kayıtlara geçti.
Bu devasa başarının zirvesinde ise doğrudan karanlık tarafa ait olan efsanevi ışın kılıcı yer aldı.
Vader'ın orijinal kılıcı, serinin en unutulmaz sahnelerinden biri olan The Empire Strikes Back filmindeki efsanevi Cloud City yüzleşmesinde ve Vader'ın kimliğinin ortaya çıktığı dönüm noktasında kullanıldı. Aynı zamanda Return of the Jedi filminde de boy gösteren bu silah, orijinal üçlemenin en kritik iki yapımını birbirine bağlıyor.
Heritage İcra Başkan Yardımcısı Joe Maddalena, iki dünya rekorunun aynı günde kırılmasının Star Wars tarihi için olağanüstü bir kutlama olduğunu belirtti.
Darth Vader'ın ışın kılıcı 4.875.000 dolar fiyatla satıldı. Bu rakam, Tom Jung'un A New Hope için hazırladığı orijinal poster tablosunun 3.875.000 dolarlık eski rekorunu tam 1 milyon dolar farkla geride bıraktı.
Eser, Luke Skywalker'ın ışın kılıcı ve kopmuş el efekt riginin Temmuz 2026'da ulaştığı 3.750.000 dolarlık ekran kullanımı rekorunu da tahtından etti.
Heritage Auctions artık bir Star Wars koleksiyon ürünü, ekran kullanımlı prop, orijinal sanat eseri ve çekim miniatürü alanlarında dünya açık artırma rekorlarını elinde tutuyor.
Oturumlar, I. Episode'dan IX. Episode'a kadar sinema serisinin yanı sıra dizi ve yan filmleri kapsayan çok geniş bir materyal grubunu bir araya getirdi. Vader'ın kılıcının başrolü oynadığı müzayedede; aralarında en ünlü Jedi ve Sith'lere ait 28 ek ışın kılıcının bulunduğu, şimdiye kadar halka açık müzayedede bir araya getirilen en geniş ışın kılıcı koleksiyonu sergilendi.
Etkinlikte ayrıca ekran kullanımlı proplar, orijinal konsept çizimleri, imzalı film posterleri, nostaljik Kenner aksiyon figürleri ve 1977 Topps Star Wars serisinin eksiksiz 330 kartlık ultra yüksek dereceli seti de alıcılarla buluştu.

Yemek yazarı ve şef Refika Birgül ’e turşu kavanozunda neler olduğunu sorduk. Birgül kavanozda olanları şöyle anlattı: “Sebzelerin üzerindeki faydalı bakteriler devreye girer ve fermantasyon başlar. Bu bakteriler, sebzelerin doğal şekerlerini laktik aside dönüştürür; turşuya o güzel, ekşi lezzetini veren şey budur.” Şef Bilgül’ün turşunun ABC’si sayılacak temel sorulara verdiği yanıtlar da şöyle:
◊ Açılmadıysa serin, karanlık yerde 1 yıl dayanır. Açıldıktan sonra mutlaka buzdolabında saklayın ve sebzeler her zaman salamuranın içinde kalsın. Bu şekilde de 2-3 ay çok rahat, buzdolabınız soğuksa 6 aya kadar dayanır.
◊ Sonbaharın gelmesiyle kızaramayan domatesler, kavun olamamış keleklerin turşu olmak için tam zamanı. Bunun dışında acur, lahana, havuç, salatalık, kornişon, her türlü biber, yeşil erik, karnabahar, pancar hatta yumurtanın bile turşusunu kurabilirsiniz.
◊ En az 3 hafta, idealde 4-6 hafta sonra ekşi tadını ve çıtır yapısını kazanır. Soğukta daha uzun sürer, sıcakta daha kısa ama kontrolsüz olur. Rengi değişir. Tadına bakarak anlamak en kolayı.
◊ Ortamdaki sıcaklık dalgalanıyorsa veya fazla fermantasyon oluyorsa gaz çıkışı artar. Tuz azsa yine fermantasyon artar ve köpürür. Kapağı fırlatabilir. Bu yüzden serin ve sabit bir yerde saklamak önemli.
◊ Sirke baştan asitlik sağladığı için daha güvenli ama daha az probiyotiktir. Sirkesiz olanlar daha probiyotik ama bozulma, sıcaklıktan etkilenme riski daha fazladır.
◊ Sirke (asetik asit) daha kararlı ve güvenli. Limon (sitrik asit) daha keskin ama dengesiz. En güzeli baz olarak sirke kullanıp biraz limon suyu ve kabuğu eklemek.
◊ Fermantasyonu hızlandırmak için. Nohut, ekşi maya ekmek fermantasyonu kuvvetle başlatır.
◊ Başta fermantasyonu tetiklesin, sarımsakla beraber en dipten yukarı aroma versin diye.
◊ Çoğu zaman laktik asit bakterisidir, zararsızdır. Yıkayıp turşuyu yemeye devam edebilirsiniz. Ama beyazlık tüylü ya da küf gibi görünüyorsa atın.
◊ İçindeki katkı maddeleri salamurayı bulandırır ve fermantasyonu bozar. İyotsuz, kayatuzu ya da deniz tuzu kullanmak en iyisi.
◊ Tuz azsa ya da sirke çoksa sebzeler yumuşar. Ayrıca tanin eksikliği de sebep olur; asma yaprağı, defne yaprağı mutlaka koyun.
◊ Topraktaki bakır oranından olabilir. Zararsızdır, gönül rahatlığıyla yiyebilirsiniz. Ama salamura mavi/küf gibi olursa atın.
◊ Plastik hafif olduğundan, esnediğinden veya taşıması kolay olduğundan tercih edilir ama cam her zaman en sağlıklısıdır.
◊ 5-6 nohut veya bir parça ekşi maya ekmeği veya 1 tatlı kaşığı ekşi maya
◊ Ekşi maya ekmeği fermantasyonu çok daha güçlü başlatır; beyaz ekmek o kadar etkili değildir ama aktif ekşi maya gerçek kahramandır.
◊ Salatalık, kornişon, acur, yeşil/olgunlaşmamış domates, ham kavun, yeşil erik, beyaz veya mor lahana, soğan, sarımsak, havuç, pancar, her çeşit biber, karnabahar...
◊ Kavanozunuzu, kapağınızı ve aletlerinizi iyice temizleyin.
◊ Ezilmiş ya da yumuşamış kısımları ayıklayın. Büyük sebzeleri kesin ya da birkaç yerinden delin.
◊ Salamura suyunuzu doğru oranda hazırlayın: Su+sirke+limon+tuz.
◊ Çok sirke koyarsanız sebzeler yumuşar. Az sirke koyarsanız küflenme riski olur.
◊ Sarımsak hem tadına katkı sağlar hem de koruma için gereklidir.
◊ Kavanozu doldurmaya başlayın. En alta nohut/ekmek ve sarımsak koyun.
◊ En üste bir asma veya defne yaprağı koyun ve kapağı kapatın. Yaprak hem sebzeleri suyun altında tutar hem de içeriğindeki tanin sayesinde çıtırlığı korur.
◊ Serin (18-22 derece) ve karanlık yerde saklayın. Sıcak ortamda turşular ‘eriyip’ yumuşar.
◊ Lahanayı çok bölmeden iri parçalara kesin. 2 parmak genişliğinde dilimlemeniz yeterli.
◊ 2 tane iri havucun kabuğunu bıçağın tersiyle sıyırın ve 1 santimetre kalınlığında küpler halinde doğrayın.
◊ 3 tane salatalığı havuçlardan daha kalın olacak şekilde halkalara doğrayın.
◊ 4 tane acı bibere bıçakla delikler açın. Bu sayede biberin acısı turşu suyuna daha hızlı girecek. 3 diş sarımsağı uzunlamasına ince kesin.
◊ Geniş bir kâseye bir avuç lahana, bir avuç havuç, bir avuç salatalık,1-2 tane biber ve 2-3 dilim sarımsağı ekleyin. Tüm sebzeler bitene kadar kat kat bu işlemi yapın. Kâsenin en üstüne 4-5 dal maydanozun yapraklarını koyun.
◊ Sosu için bir kâseye 100 ml zeytinyağı, 100 ml sirke, 1 çorba kaşığı kayatuzu, 1 adet limonun suyu ve 1 su bardağı su koyup karıştırın.
◊ Limonu sıkmadan tezgâh üzerinde ezerek gözeneklerini patlatın ki sıkarken daha fazla suyu çıksın.
◊ Kâse içindeki sebzeleri sıkarak yumuşatın. Hazırladığınız sosu sebzelerin üzerine gezdirin ve yine sıkarak alt üst yapın. Sebzeleri sostan nasiplendirin. Kâseye 4-5 buz atın ve bir tabakla üzerini kapatın. Sallayarak karıştırın.
◊ Turşuyu 1 gece üzeri kapalı bir şekilde buzdolabında bekletin. Ertesi gün lezzetiyle mest olacağınız hızlı turşu hazır…
◊ 2 tane kırmızı soğanı halka halka doğrayın. Turşu kavanozunun dibine bir kısmını dizin.
◊ Üzerine toplamda bir çorba kaşığı kadar olacak şekilde kişniş tohumu, sumak, tane karabiberi ekleyin. Geriye kalan soğanları ve baharat çeşnilerini aynı şekilde iki kat daha olacak şekilde yerleştirin.
◊ Sürahiye 1 çorba kaşığı kaya tuzunu dökün, 5 çorba kaşığı sirke ve 250 ml su ilave edip tuz eriyene kadar karıştırın.
◊ Soğuyana kadar dışarıda, soğuduktan sonra buzdolabında 1 hafta beklettikten sonra emrinize amade.

A special occasion for Andy Robertson saw Scotland flirt with embarrassment. Collection of his 102nd cap moves him level with Kenny Dalglish in the all-time Scottish list. Robertson will soon be a record holder. This was, however, John McGinn’s night. A double from McGinn, the second a penalty, spared Scottish blushes against a North Macedonia team who threatened to administer red faces to those in navy blue.
This proved an almighty struggle for Scotland . Questions – and plenty of them – surround whether or not Sébastien Pocognoli can build on the excellent work of his predecessor Steve Clarke. For now, Scotland are a tough watch. Pocognoli looks tactically inflexible and this is not the new dawn many predicted.
“At times it wasn’t pretty,” admitted McGinn. The 32-year-old compared this Scotland process to a club team starting a new season. The rationale is fair enough, were this a remotely forgiving environment.
It was Robertson who led the dressing room inquest in the immediate aftermath of last month’s defeat to Slovenia. It is not in the Tottenham full-back’s make-up to personalise scenarios but shortcomings in the last international window, Pocognoli’s first as the Scotland manager, added to the sense that the bigger picture was important here. North Macedonia looked favourable visitors, having not scored a goal in eight outings.
Pocognoli could call upon Kieran Tierney, Scott McTominay and Ché Adams for the first time and deployed all three from the outset. It already appears the Belgian coach will not deviate from a back three. Ben Gannon-Doak took his place at right wingback, as is feasible against such weak opposition. Scotland’s approach will inevitably change for Monday’s meeting with Switzerland.
Scotland had been ponderous until McTominay came within an excellent Stole Dimitrievski save of properly announcing his international return. The midfielder swivelled and struck, with Dimitrievski equal to the Napoli man’s effort.
Robertson was denied the opportunity to mark his special night with a goal by an errant whistle. The referee hauled play back for a Scotland free kick – McTominay had been upended – when the playing of advantage would have seen Robertson collect a Billy Gilmour pass in a scoring position. The Hampden crowd mumped and moaned, which rather summed up recent attitudes around this Scotland team. It feels as if the public are not yet fully engaged with Pocognoli’s project. Adams sought to lift the mood, the striker stooping for a header that took a deflection before Dimitrievski batted away.
In backing up their statistical position, North Macedonia were providing nothing by way of attacking threat. Their enjoyment came from frustrating the Scots. McTominay, who has previous for acrobatic excellence in this arena, tried a 34th minute bicycle kick that flew over the crossbar and Scotland’s most lively player tried again with a low shot which Dimitrievski blocked with his midriff. This lack of cutting edge was a Scottish concern long before Pocognoli entered the dugout. The boos that met the half-time whistle, seconds after North Macedonia had created their first chance of the evening, depicted a supporter base who remained unconvinced.
Less than a minute of the second half had been played when Gilmour produced one of the worst misses ever witnessed at this famous old venue. Calamity in the North Macedonia defence allowed Adams to steal in. The Torino striker laid the ball back to Gilmour six yards out and, with an open goal, he blazed his shot wildly over the bar. It was a genuine, utter howler.
Route one broke the deadlock for Scotland. Ryan Porteous’s looping header from the halfway line caused panic in the North Macedonia defence. Adams capitalised, his pass to the advancing McGinn setting up the Aston Villa midfielder’s 23rd goal for his country. Relief was as obvious as celebration.
Although a North Macedonia response was not in the script, the equaliser epitomised Scottish slackness. A near post run from Elmin Rastoder saw him meet a menacing Enis Bardhi corner from the left. Angus Gunn in the home goal was helpless as Rastoder flicked home.
North Macedonia clearly now sensed Scottish vulnerability. While Pocognoli’s men continued to dominate the ball, North Macedonia’s counterattacking threat had increased. Officialdom, and sharp footwork from Gannon-Doak, were soon to come to Scotland’s rescue.
Gannon-Doak was instantly convinced of the foul by Dimitrievski after the Bournemouth man tried to skip past the goalkeeper. It took the VAR to inform the referee that the incident was worthy of further inspection. Intriguingly, it was not Oli McBurnie – still awaiting his maiden Scotland goal and on in place of Adams – who took the spot-kick. Up stepped McGinn, who made no mistake. While Gannon-Doak is due credit for winning the penalty, this appearance once more raised serious questions about his decision making.
That of the Scottish FA in hiring Pocognoli would be open to question had North Macedonia delivered a shock. That they did not do so spared Scotland ignominy. “It was not always perfect,” said Pocognoli. You aren’t kidding, Sébastien.

As Scotland legend Kenny Dalglish watched one of his records equalled in Scotland's 2-1 win over North Macedonia, another of his feats loomed into view.
The night was supposed to be about Andy Robertson joining Dalglish as Scotland's most-capped man, the Tottenham left-back making his 102nd appearance for his country.
But instead, for the first time, the 75-year-old might be nervous that his crown as one of Scotland men's all-time top goalscorers is wobbling.
That is because, in Scotland's rather humdrum Nations League victory, John McGinn - in his 94th Scotland appearance - took two big strides towards the record.
The Aston Villa midfielder now has 24 goals for his country - six shy of Dalglish's long-standing record of 30, shared with Denis Law.
"It's something that's been in the back of my head," McGinn admitted in the post-match debrief. "If I start climbing that table, it means we've been successful as a team."
Now 32 years old, time is running out for him. But as he pulls level with Hughie Gallacher, one of the Wembley Wizards of folklore, his ambition is clear.
There was a time when talk of this record being toppled seemed laughable. Scotland has produced strikers in recent decades, but none close to Dalglish or Law.
The fact a midfielder might take the title makes McGinn's feat all the more astonishing.
His prowess in front of goal is no secret to the Tartan Army. There was the spell at the end of 2019 where he scored six in three games, his overhead kick against Austria, his late winner against Croatia in 2024.
But of late, his lack of goals and even his performances have had some fans questioning where he fits into the Scotland team.
"It has been a bit of a dry patch for me over the last year on the goal front," McGinn admitted, and he's not wrong.
He failed to find the back of the net for Scotland in 2025, the first time he'd done that since 2020.
But, just as his form at Villa has sky-rocketed, he came up big for his new international head coach Sebastien Pocognoli.
"Isn't it great to have a John McGinn in your team?" former Scotland winger Pat Nevin said on Sportsound. "He's somebody you'd want to have in your team to be taking a penalty for you.
"I'd be surprised if John McGinn doesn't get the goal record now. It might take him another year or two, but he is definitely capable of getting that record."
Becoming Scotland's main penalty taker will help, a fact McGinn alluded to coyly post-match.
In his career, he had only taken one spot-kick before this season - scoring for Scotland in the 3-3 draw against Norway back in 2023.
In this campaign he has scored three and missed one, smacking the bar against Fulham on Halloween.
In classic McGinn fashion, he bounced back to slot home against Manchester United the following week, before being caught on ref-cam admitting to the official that he was nervous to take it after his hitting the woodwork.
That jovial, lovable personality has not just won him fans off the pitch. It is clear that his team-mates at both Villa and the national team adore him.
"He's not going to stop until he [gets the record]," said striker Che Adams, who helped set up McGinn's first against North Macedonia.
"Everyone's pleased for him, he's the best person I've met in football. For him to get the recognition he deserves is amazing."
McGinn's iconic status in Scottish football is secure and will not be tarnished if he fails to climb the mountain.
Whether it is being speared by Steven Thompson in training, calling Scotland performances 'jobby', or admitting he would "probably be at Yeovil" were it not for his backside, the midfielder has already won the heart of a nation.
